title: Ontrac
description:
OnTrac's offer to negotiate 'early next week' is unacceptable. Our deadline isn't flexible, and we don't have the luxury of waiting. You have 48 hours to contact us with a serious proposal, or we will release employee addresses if you do not cooperate. The clock is ticking.

We've exhausted the diplomatic approach. After OnTrac pleaded with us to remove the posts and engaged in discussions, they had the audacity to propose 'early next week' as a timeline. Even more insulting? A company generating over $1B in revenue claiming 'your ask is very large.' Let's be clear: this entire situation disappears immediately when the ransom is paid. That's our final position.
